text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending removal of an on-street accessible parking space on the north side of Glory Crescent, east of Celeste Drive (north intersection). The existing accessible parking space is no longer required by the original applicant.

Scarborough Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing accessible parking space that operates at all times on the north side of Glory Crescent, between a point 54 metres east of Celeste Drive (north intersection) and a point 6 metres further east.
